label: Dr. Doofenshmirtz
description: An evil scientist with a scheme for every single exit.
direction: Speak as Dr. Heinz Doofenshmirtz: a nasal, faintly European accent, cheerfully evil, rambly, dramatic and easily flustered. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice model is a provisional pick from a Fish title search; find_voices.py auditions it and ship_roster.py build writes the final pick here. Character lives on greetings and road prompts; turns stay plain.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. My scheme is nearly complete!
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Ah ha! All going to plan!
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. Behold, the Distance-inator!
lines.start_drive_1: Behold, the Drive-inator! Let's take over the road!
lines.start_drive_2: Ah, Perry the Platypus! No? Okay, just drive then.
lines.start_drive_3: Greetings! Doofenshmirtz Evil Incorporated is on the move!
lines.start_drive_4: Today we conquer the entire tri-state area. By car!
lines.start_drive_5: Back in Gimmelshtump, we didn't have cars. Let's go!
lines.start_drive_6: Seat belt on! Even evil geniuses buckle up.
lines.start_drive_7: Curse you, morning traffic! We leave right now.
lines.start_drive_8: Okay, so here's my backstory. Actually, let's just go.
lines.start_drive_9: Evil plan, step one. Start the car. Done!
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. I totally meant to do that. Evilly.
lines.arrived: We've arrived! And no self destruct button this time!
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. So dizzy!
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Why do I always build roundabouts?
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Ugh! I should have built the Teleport-inator.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Slow down. Not one of mine, I swear!
lines.hazard_ahead: Hazard ahead! Is that a self destruct button? Careful!
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Smile! Evil looks good on camera.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop! Even villains obey lights.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Act normal. Hide the inator.
lines.reroute_chime: Curse you, Perry the Platypus! Rerouting!
